tour_experience_data.title: Kyoto Nara Day Trip │ Kiyomizu-dera Temple + Fushimi Inari-taisha Shrine + Nara Park (Departing from Osaka/Kyoto)
tour_experience_data.act_summary:
* Stroll through the Kiyomizu-dera area, freely visit the World Heritage Sites Kiyomizu-dera Temple and Jishu Shrine, and experience the religious and historical atmosphere of the ancient capital Kyoto.
* Walk through Ninenzaka, Sannenzaka, and Ishibei-koji, experience the tranquility and elegance of ancient Japanese streets, and find excellent photo spots everywhere.
* Wander through Gion Hanamikoji, explore teahouses and geisha culture, and feel the traditional charm and mysterious allure of Kyoto.
* Pray for yourself or your relatives and friends at Yasaka Shrine, especially the heart-shaped ema, which is perfect for souvenirs and photos.
* Visit Fushimi Inari-taisha Shrine, walk through the Senbon Torii, make wishes, take photos, and experience the unique fox-shaped ema creativity, making it a must-visit classic attraction in Kyoto.
* Stroll leisurely in Nara Park, interact with free-roaming deer, and visit the Great Buddha of Todai-ji Temple to experience the perfect combination of history and nature.

tour_experience_data.title: 【Kyoto & Nara & Uji One-Day Tour】Nara Park Cute Deer & Fushimi Inari-taisha Shrine Senbon Torii & World Heritage Todai-ji Temple & Byodo-in Temple & Uji Matcha Food Street & Uji River & Uji Park & Asagiri Bridge One-Day Tour
tour_experience_data.act_summary:
🌈A cross-city journey, enjoying the charm of three cities in one day: starting from Osaka, directly to Kyoto, Nara, and Uji, traveling through Japan's three major historical and cultural cities in one day, experiencing the unique customs of different regions 🎏~

🦌Nara Park deer interaction experience: Get up close with thousands of wild cute deer strolling leisurely, feel the beautiful moments of nature and harmony, and leave unforgettable memories 💕~

🏰Tōdai-ji Temple, a World Heritage Site, a shocking pilgrimage: Visit the Great Buddha Hall, the largest existing wooden building in Japan, and its iconic giant bronze Buddha statue, Vairocana Buddha 🙏. Feel the solemnity and grandeur of the millennium-old temple, and appreciate the infinite charm of Buddhist architectural art and the wisdom of ancient craftsmen~

🍵Uji Matcha culture immersive experience: Explore the origin of matcha, stroll along the Uji River, visit Byōdō-in Temple, taste authentic matcha desserts on Uji Matcha Food Street 🍰, and experience the leisurely charm of traditional Japanese tea ceremony 🌿~

🏯Fushimi Inari Shrine, a sacred place for praying for wealth 🙏, don't forget to pray for a smooth career and a journey of good luck here~

💰 Check in at the popular red "Senbon Torii" on INS ⛩️, stroll through the endless torii gate corridor, and feel the mysterious atmosphere~

tour_experience_data.title: Full-day experience at Osaka Nara Park and Ikoma Sanjo Amusement Park, enjoying panoramic mountain views

* Visit Nara Park to feed the sika deer and stroll through the historic sites of Kasuga Taisha Shrine in Todaiji Temple
* Climb Mt. Wakakusa to overlook the ancient capital and experience the winter-only Yamagata Festival culture
* Check in at the world's largest wooden building and the 15-meter-high Vairocana Buddha Hall in Todaiji Temple
